metadata.description: Skills for Agentic Intelligence - specialized capabilities for development workflows

plugins.name: ai-daily-digest
plugins.description: Daily AI news digest covering technical advances, business news, and engineering impact

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Council of 27 sourced engineering and UX persona agents that review code, design docs, architecture, refactors, UI surfaces, dashboards, and strategy through opinionated lenses, then synthesize convergence, disagreement, and concrete next moves.

plugins.name: service-mesh-debug
plugins.description: Diagnose and fix flaky e2e tests and connectivity issues in service mesh environments (Kuma, Istio, Linkerd, Consul). 11 root causes, Envoy debug scripts, minimal fixes.

plugins.name: gh-review-comments
plugins.description: List, reply to, resolve, and create GitHub PR review comment threads

plugins.name: git-clean-gone
plugins.description: Clean up local branches with deleted remote tracking and their worktrees

plugins.name: git-stage-hunk
plugins.description: Non-interactive hunk staging for selective git add without TTY

plugins.name: go-code-review
plugins.description: Auto-review Go code for 100+ common mistakes from 100go.co. Checks error handling, concurrency, interfaces, performance, testing, and stdlib usage.

plugins.name: humanize
plugins.description: Make text sound natural by removing AI writing patterns

plugins.name: kubecon-cfp
plugins.description: Interactive KubeCon CFP submission writer with data-driven insights from 1,100+ accepted talks

plugins.name: plan-critic
plugins.description: Critique a Claude implementation plan before approving execution. Spawns parallel persona subagents (Skeptic, Architect, Verifier) to evaluate the plan against the codebase.

plugins.name: promptgen
plugins.description: Turn rough instructions into optimized, evidence-based prompts for AI agents

plugins.name: refactor-council
plugins.description: Refactoring review through 7 sourced refactoring personas (Fowler, Uncle Bob, Feathers, Beck, Metz, Ousterhout, Tornhill): scans smells + git hotspots, synthesizes a safety-first plan, then an adversary red-teams it.

plugins.name: review-claude-md
plugins.description: Audit and fix CLAUDE.md files using tiered binary checklist

plugins.name: staff-code-review
plugins.description: Staff-engineer-level code review evaluating architectural alignment, failure modes, observability, security, and cross-team impact.

plugins.name: staff-resume
plugins.description: Build and refine staff-level engineering resumes through interactive coaching, research-backed best practices, and per-job tailoring

plugins.name: test-writer
plugins.description: Write tests that verify behavior (not implementation), use table-driven/parameterized patterns, and minimize mocking. Supports Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, and Rust.
